rubric.description: Declares and initializes a counter variable to 0
Uses a loop that iterates through the positive integers less than limit
Correctly tests whether each value is a multiple of factor (e.g. using i % factor == 0)
Declares and initializes a sum accumulator to 0
Uses a while loop that continues while n > 0
Correctly extracts the last digit (e.g. n % 10) and adds it to the sum
Correctly removes the last digit each iteration (e.g. n /= 10) and returns the sum
Declares and initializes a counter variable to 0
Uses nested loops, an outer loop for i and an inner loop for j
The inner loop starts at i + 1 (or equivalent) so that i < j always holds, avoiding double-counting
